items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I know Spencer Odum (PHONETIC), who's passed, too.

ctx.x: Do you know who the musicians were that were in the front line in his band?
Oh, boy, let me see. John Levy would know. I know Spencer Odum (PHONETIC), who's passed, too. Used to play with the Southernairs, the quartet that used to come
